research_decision: Do not prioritize classical polynomial menus of affine directions as the native batch compiler. Their clean predicate and inverse are cheap, but support rank makes their typical raw success superpolynomially small. Nonlinear partitions and costed coherent direction interference remain open.

proof_obligations.PO-INPUT: Original even-native integer-secret phase model, independent uniform full frequency pairs; reduction modulo3 gives independent uniform A and B.
proof_obligations.PO-CLEAN: For a supplied nonzero low-label-only v, x maps reversibly to (x-x_p*v,x_p). Compute/copy/uncompute the success predicate before measuring the quotient. No retained arithmetic garbage or preparation inverse.
proof_obligations.PO-CURVATURE: Both B*v^2=0 AND the derivative predicate must vanish. A zero curvature vector alone does not imply accepted lines exist.
proof_obligations.PO-COVERAGE: True success is0 or3^(-rank(B_support)); charge actual source consumption and all discarded parent batches. One accepted batch yields one child, not all potential tags.
proof_obligations.PO-RANDOM: Review the sparse kernel union bound and the minimal dependent-column argument. It applies uniformly to classical menus chosen after seeing all low labels, without assuming independent directions.
proof_obligations.PO-SCOPE: The obstruction covers unions of good original affine lines only. Do not apply it to coherent direction superpositions, nonlinear partitions, noncommuting state reshaping or source-state-only approximate transforms.
proof_obligations.PO-DIRECTION: Supplied-direction arithmetic has a polynomial construction; an efficient favorable direction finder is not supplied. Exhaustive calibration search is not scalable.
proof_obligations.PO-CHILD: A low-only accepted tag has raw Born mass3^(1-M), exact child phase at q/3, and the conditional IID high-lift law. Fresh batches are required for independent outputs.
proof_obligations.PO-REVIEW: Derivations and novelty require external mathematical review. No generic quantum lower bound, new efficient solver or LWE attack is claimed.

falsifiers: A true native quadratic or accepted line fails its whole-source frequency identity.
The explicit coordinate map drops a word or preserves dirty workspace.
Complete native coverage differs from the exact rank formula.
A sparse-kernel-free label instance admits a feasible direction with too small a support rank.
A classical menu exceeds its exact population probability bound without leaving the stated model.
